gaps.explanation: p5 (printed p16) governmental funds statement: Transfers in General Fund 29,781 (= Total; JSON statement). Detail General Fund lines come from the departmental combining statement pp15-16 (printed p48), which prints transfers between General Fund departments: Transfers in Administrative (12,949), Police 19,207, Fire 23,523, Cemetery 59,460 (Total column 89,241); Transfers out Administrative (59,460). Positive transfer lines 19,207 + 23,523 + 59,460 = 102,190; 102,190 - 12,949 - 59,460 = 29,781 = the fund statement. The 72,409 (Administrative net transfers (72,409)) moves money between General Fund departments and is netted on the fund statement. All printed; no fix here (the Administrative (12,949) label is corrected in the 'other financing' entry below).

p5 (printed p16): Transfers out Street (6,258) + Other Governmental (23,523) = 29,781 (JSON statement). Detail negative transfer lines: Street Fund (6,258) (p13) + Special Fire Fund (23,523) (p14) + General Fund Administrative department (59,460) and (12,949) (p15) = 102,190. The 59,460 + 12,949 = 72,409 are intra-General-Fund departmental transfers (to Cemetery 59,460; Police/Fire), offset inside the General Fund (the General Fund column prints no transfers out). No fix.

Mislabelled transfer line: detail[118] (General Fund departmental combining statement p15, printed p48, Administrative column) is -12,949 labelled 'Transfers In' (printed '(12,949)' on the Transfers in row). A negative transfer is money leaving the department, so it is re-added as 'Transfers Out' with the same amount. Net effect on detail totals 0.
